surfaces.surface: A tool writes, replaces, moves or deletes a file.
A tool runs a shell command, and the processes that command starts.
The local Office editor writes the open document back to the workspace.

authorization.external: The workspace upload implementation the Host wires in: the editor sends the revision it opened as If-Match and that implementation decides.

surfaces.surface: A caller creates, edits, submits or reviews an enterprise record such as a contact, an inventory item, an order or a task.
A native automation step acts on the operator's desktop.
An update artifact is downloaded and accepted for installation.

authorization.external: The signature trust root configured for the release channel: an expected hash or a signature verifier supplied by the updater's configuration.

surfaces.surface: A tool, model provider or MCP server opens an outbound network connection.
surfaces.reason: No component in this checkout gates outbound traffic. The sandbox vocabulary covers file effects only and says so: `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/index.ts` — “Network and process visibility are outside this vocabulary.” The sandbox modes confine file effects, and no egress allow-list or deny-list exists to name.

surfaces.surface: A tool runs model-written code in a worker thread.
surfaces.reason: This inventory has not established the gate. `packages/code-runtime/code-runtime-worker-thread/src/index.ts` documents model code as having bash-equivalent trust with an empty environment and measured budgets, but which component refuses an out-of-budget or out-of-namespace call is not established here.

surfaces.surface: A model request reaches a tool that a configured MCP server exposes.
surfaces.reason: This inventory has not established the gate. No approval or refusal reference appears in `packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/index.ts`, and whether the tool layer's approval applies to server-provided tools is not established here.

surfaces.surface: The agent inspects or mounts a plugin or service at runtime.
surfaces.reason: This inventory has not established the gate. `packages/README.md` describes `packages/extensions/` as “Agent runtime self-modification: live plugin/service inspection and model-written mount/unmount”, and no refusal path for a mount has been identified here.
